recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17462 unless a future terminology decision changes THO/v3 marital status content or the Patient/Person maritalStatus binding.
issue_request: FHIR-17462 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration change request to remove the FHIR-defined Marital Status CodeSystem and its page because the missing v3 concept had been resolved and the FHIR CodeSystem was no longer referenced.
initial_application: No git commit was found that names FHIR-17462 directly. The same source removal was applied by commit 6fc4d3572997f7944371158e8a12dd5f511e1dfc under related tracker FHIR-16319, deleting source/terminologies/codesystem-marital-status.xml; the FHIR-17462 Jira comments also state that codesystem-marital-status was removed.
additional_context: FHIR-16319 is the same-change-family Published issue whose implementation commit removed the obsolete file, and FHIR-16229 is a duplicate describing the same confusing one-code CodeSystem. Zulip PA discussion confirmed the intent to remove the FHIR CodeSystem page while retaining the marital-status ValueSet, and later PA Confluence minutes discuss v3 marital status harmonization rather than restoring a core CodeSystem.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source has no source/terminologies/codesystem-marital-status.xml, no active fhir.ini CodeSystem entry for marital-status, and no current source reference to the old http://hl7.org/fhir/marital-status CodeSystem URL. The remaining source/terminologies/valueset-marital-status.xml is still in use by active Patient and Person maritalStatus bindings and correctly composes from THO v3 CodeSystems.
